title: ImUi Child Region ResizeX v1

repro.summary: Start from the existing child-region resize proof and add the horizontal handle / app-owned width response surface in `fret-ui-kit::imui`.

cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui child_region_resize --no-fail-fast
